Are you the mysterious letter “X” we are looking for?

Join ProX Group to take part directly in building Vietnamese tech products and taking them to global markets.

01. UA Marketing (User Acquisition)

Full-time | Hanoi

Location: 4th Floor, 60B Nguyen Huy Tuong Building, Thanh Xuan Ward, Hanoi
Working hours: Monday–Friday, 08:30–18:00 (lunch break 12:00–13:30)

Responsibilities

  • Market mobile apps for global markets, especially the US and Europe
  • Take part in building and growing apps/games with millions of active users
  • Analyze user data to continuously improve and optimize the user experience
  • Build and manage marketing activities, tracking metrics such as CAC, ROI, ROAS, LTV, CTR, CVR and CPI
  • Own budgeting and P&L
  • Optimize the conversion rate of store listing elements on Google Play and the App Store
  • Report results directly to the executive team and work with teams and projects across the company

Benefits

  • Income that matches your capability (base salary + KPI pay + commission): Junior VND 14,000,000 – 25,000,000 + commission; Middle–Senior up to VND 40,000,000 + commission
  • Salary reviews twice a year (no cap on raises) and promotion opportunities
  • 13–15 months of salary per year, plus holiday gifts (bonuses) for New Year’s Day, National Day, 30/04–01/05, Mid-Autumn Festival, Children’s Day and more
  • Take part in the app development process for the UK and US markets, with millions of users and growth above 50% per month, including apps ranking among the top charts in the US/UK and handling hundreds of thousands of requests per day
  • Bonuses at different levels tied to project milestones, delivery performance or new improvement initiatives
  • Encouraged to join requirements analysis and system design, with resources and investment to develop your own ideas (a monthly internal innovation day, where the top ideas get funded)
  • Free parking and a daily tea break
  • Young, energetic colleagues who always support one another
  • A civilized, fair workplace with a dynamic startup spirit, where you are free to propose improvements
  • Social insurance, health insurance and other benefits as required by law

Requirements

  • University degree in Business, Marketing, PR or a related field
  • At least 1 year of UA marketing experience in mobile apps
  • Experience managing or leading a marketing team is an advantage
  • Proficient with the main ad channels: Facebook Ads, Google Ads (App Campaigns), Unity, AppLovin, IronSource...
  • Familiar with tracking and analytics tools (Adjust, AppsFlyer, Firebase, Tableau or GA4)
  • Creative thinking about ad content, and able to work well with the Design team to produce effective materials
  • Able to apply AI to support your work
  • Experience in the US–UK market and running high budgets is an advantage
  • Proactive, ready to try new things and handle high pressure in a startup model
  • English reading comprehension (IELTS 5.5 or above, or an equivalent certificate)
02. Intern Creative

Internship | Hanoi

Responsibilities

  • Optimize keywords and product content, and build ASO-standard content sets
  • Conduct market research
  • Come up with ideas and create content and ad scripts
  • Edit short videos and images for TikTok Ads, Facebook Ads, Google Ads... to advertise and promote mobile game/app products
  • Carry out tasks assigned by the team
  • Coordinate with other departments for effective teamwork

Benefits

  • Base salary of VND 4,000,000 per month
  • First 3 months: assessment of job fit. With good or excellent results, you continue in the ProxLab program and the support salary is adjusted
  • Next 2 months: evaluation for official employment, with an improved package
  • Take part in the app development process for the UK and US markets, with millions of users and growth above 50% per month, including apps ranking among the top charts in the US/UK and handling hundreds of thousands of requests per day
  • Bonuses at different levels tied to project milestones, delivery performance or new improvement initiatives
  • Encouraged to join requirements analysis and system design, with resources and investment to develop your own ideas (a monthly internal innovation day, where the top ideas get funded)
  • Free parking and a daily tea break
  • Young, energetic colleagues who always support one another
  • A civilized, fair workplace with a dynamic startup spirit, where you are free to propose improvements
  • Social insurance, health insurance and other benefits as required by law

Requirements

  • Good English reading comprehension (around TOEIC 600 / IELTS 5.5)
  • Basic marketing knowledge
  • Able to use editing software: CapCut, Adobe Premiere
  • Able to use AI at work and passionate about exploring new AI tools to boost productivity
  • Making TikTok content or running a channel is a big advantage
  • Good communication, creativity, teamwork and a proactive attitude
  • Available for at least 8 sessions per week
03. Product Owner (IAP)

Full-time | Hanoi

Responsibilities

  • Come up with ideas and features for useful mobile app products
  • Research users with tools such as Google Play, Sensor Tower, App Annie, Google Console and Firebase; consolidate data and propose product improvements and solutions
  • Run A/B tests on product improvement options
  • Monitor results and make decisive, accurate decisions on how products are distributed to users
  • Work with Designers and Developers to build, release and improve mobile app products
  • Apply the Scrum model and use Jira to manage the task list and keep projects on schedule

Benefits

  • Salary: up to VND 30,000,000
  • 13–15 months of salary per year, plus holiday gifts (bonuses) for New Year’s Day, National Day, 30/04–01/05, Mid-Autumn Festival, Children’s Day and more
  • Annual trips, kick-offs and team-building
  • Free parking and a daily tea break
  • Social insurance, health insurance and other benefits as required by law
  • Salary reviews twice a year
  • Training in mobile app expertise along the company’s learning roadmap
  • Access to large international products with millions of users
  • Freedom to create global mobile apps, with no outsourcing for foreign clients
  • A dynamic tech startup environment that keeps improving, learning and sharing new things
  • Bonuses at different levels tied to project milestones, delivery performance or new improvement initiatives
  • Authority to manage projects with a full product team (Marketing, UI/UX Design, Dev, Tester, PM)

Requirements

  • More than 1 year of experience as a PO (having worked on IAP products) or in equivalent roles
  • Willing to learn, research and keep up with new technologies
  • Strong ability to apply AI at work
  • Data-driven mindset: make judgments and decisions based on numbers
  • Strong systems thinking, clear logic, self-learning ability and a love of creating
  • Good English reading comprehension of documents
